name: ⭐ Work at a Dentist!
desc:
"Your smile begins here."

Hygiene Dentist is a virtual dentist role-playing game where Patients can come to have their teeth examined. We offer a multitude of services; cleanings, fillings, crowns, these are just some of the services we offer!

Want to support us and our community? Join the group! https://www.roblox.com/groups/4234871/Hygiene

We are always on the lookout for staff members, if you are interested in becoming one, feel free to apply in game!
